title: The $W_n$ Light One-Point Torus Conformal Block
summary: We study the light asymptotic limit of the one-point torus conformal block in $A_{n-1}$ Toda field theory. Through the AGT correspondence, this problem can be translated into the computation of the instanton partition function of four-dimensional ${\cal N}=2^{\ast}$ $U(n)$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory, which we then examine in the limit $b\to 0$ at fixed conformal dimensions. We show that, in this regime, the instanton sum simplifies drastically: for each Young diagram, only boxes with specific arm lengths contribute to the bifundamental factors.
